messages:
carol-partner-ops: Heads-up — carrier flagged a customs hold on CN-SEA manifest. Two containers with APAC Dedicated reserve are blocked. ETA sliding from 3/28 -> unknown. Need a quick redistribution + customer comms plan. Tagging logistics and procurement.

kevin-logistics: Confirmed. Carrier ref CNSEA-337. Containers cn-SEA-1432 and cn-SEA-1433. Estimated capacity impacted ~160 GPUs (A100-s). Initial ETA uncertain until doc clearance.

maya-eng: What committed capacity windows are affected? any onboarding this week?

alex-sales: AcmeCorp onboarding on 3/30 (50 GPUs, enterprise SLA). Nimbus pilot on 4/2 (40 GPUs). Acme is priority — legal penalty if delayed.

nick-procurement: We have an EU buffer: ~60 GPUs available in DE warehouse. Air freight to SG ~1 day, cost uplift ~USD 60k. Can do partial redeploy to cover Acme.

jordan-sre: Alternative: we can route burst traffic to hosted pool temporarily for Nimbus to avoid missing SLAs — will increase tail latency but keeps customers running.

carol-partner-ops: Proposal v1: 1) Air-move 40 GPUs from DE to cover Acme (hold finance approval) 2) Route Nimbus to hosted burst for first week 3) Hold final cancel for air if customs clears. Approve?

maya-eng: Technically OK. Need to pin Acme to those EU GPUs once they arrive and do a canary rollout for model versions. I can whip up a small routing change and perf watchdog.

alex-sales: Acme will accept air solution if we cover premium shipping and give clear ETA. I'll confirm verbally but assume yes for planning.

kevin-logistics: Carrier updated status: docs requested -> documents uploaded. New ETA estimate shorter, looks like 18-24h for release if no further issues. If that holds, we can cancel air.

orion-supply-bot: Shipment cn-SEA-1432 status update: HOLD -> DOCUMENTS_RECEIVED at 1749990300. System ETA updated to 1749993600 (approx +1h).

nick-procurement: Good. Hold air procurement for now. Alex please pause acceptance of uplift until we see final release.

carol-partner-ops: I'll draft comms to Acme + Nimbus. Alex, can you give a short bullet for the Acme notice (what we offer and mitigation)?

alex-sales: Draft for Acme: "We are proactively arranging a priority air transfer to ensure no disruption; we will confirm final delivery within 24 hours or revert to on-prem fallback. We will cover expedited costs and provide a dedicated success lead."

jordan-sre: Runbook note: if we enable hosted-burst for Nimbus, apply routing rule `burst-to-hosted` and a 5m alert on 99th pct latency + token rate. I can template alert.

carol-partner-ops: Thanks. Action items: Kevin keep carrier thread open and ping hourly; Nick hold air PO until 1749991500; Maya prepare routing/canary; Jordan prepare alerts; Alex finalize customer language. I'll post comms once we have final carrier confirmation.

kevin-logistics: Will do. Updating manifest and pinging customs broker now.

alex-sales: Will send provisional message to Acme after PO hold lifted.

carol-partner-ops: If customs clears in <24h we avoid $60k uplift. Otherwise, proceed with partial air for Acme.

kevin-logistics: Noted. I'll update thread when carrier moves to RELEASED. :eyes:

jordan-sre: Adding runbook link in case we need to flip routing: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/hosted-burst (ops only).

orion-supply-bot: Next automated update in 30m or on status change.
